notes: zynga.com/jobs/ 301-redirects (CloudFront) to job-boards.greenhouse.io/zyngacareers, which server-renders all 48 jobs with '48 jobs' in the page text. The only controls are Search (input#keyword-filter), Office (#office-filter) and Disciplines (custom field 4033182004); React filters the already-rendered cards client-side and there is no pagination. The companion public feed https://api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/zyngacareers/jobs?content=false returns the same 48 rows (metadata includes Disciplines, Time Type, Connected Workplace Options, Worker Type) and accepts no keyword/location filter parameters.
